title: Tech & Startup Jobs Scraper (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, SmartRecruiters + MCP) Input

boards.title: ATS Company Boards
boards.description: List of company boards in 'provider:slug' format (e.g. greenhouse:stripe, lever:spotify, ashby:openai, smartrecruiters:BoschGroup) or full ATS board URLs.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Filter jobs whose title, department, or description contains any of these keywords.

locations.title: Locations
locations.description: Filter jobs matching any of these location substrings (e.g. Remote, London, San Francisco).

departments.title: Departments
departments.description: Filter jobs matching any of these department substrings (e.g. Engineering, Sales, AI).

remoteOnly.title: Remote Only
remoteOnly.description: Only return jobs marked as remote-friendly.

postedAfter.title: Posted After (YYYY-MM-DD)
postedAfter.description: Only include jobs published on or after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

includeDescription.title: Include Full Description
includeDescription.description: Include plain-text job description in output (increases dataset size).

maxItems.title: Maximum Items
maxItems.description: Maximum number of normalized jobs to return (1–2000).
